long-covid.title: Treatment strategies in pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma: a systematic review and pooled analysis of individual cases.
long-covid.authors: Gao, Xiang Yu, Ganatra, Nency, Abdelhakeem, Ahmed, Tran, Nugyen et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma (PASC) is a rare 1-4% of all pancreatic cancers and an aggressive pancreatic malignancy characterized by mixed adenocarcinoma and squamous histologies. Even after surgical intervention, patients with PASC have a lower median overall survival (mOS) than those with the more prevalent pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).

long-covid.title: Persistently activated virus-specific CD8 T cells indicate antigen-driven immune aberrations in long COVID.
long-covid.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
long-covid.authors: Painter, Mark M, Reeg, David B, Douek, Naomi R, Gray-Gaillard, Sophie L et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Long COVID (LC) affects millions of people worldwide, yet its driving mechanisms remain incompletely defined and no treatment has been approved. Persistence of SARS-CoV-2 and reactivation of herpesviruses have been implicated in LC, but direct detection of these viral antigens in blood and tissues has been challenging.

long-covid.title: Long COVID: A Modified Delphi Consensus on Definition, Burden, Diagnosis and Management in Southeast Asia.
long-covid.authors: Burhan, Erlina, Chew, Huck Chin, Isbaniah, Fathiyah, Jogulu, Sathya Rao et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Long COVID is a heterogeneous post-infectious condition following acute severe acute respiratory syndrome-coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection. Ongoing uncertainty around its definition, burden, diagnosis and management complicates clinical recognition and care in Southeast Asia.

long-covid.excerpt: Long COVID and other infection-associated chronic conditions (IACC) present management challenges for primary care clinicians and often require patient access to multidisciplinary specialists. To strengthen primary care capacity, the Long COVID and Fatiguing Illnesses Recovery Program (LC&FIRP) implemented a multi-modal learning model combining Extension for Community Healthcare Outcomes (ECHO) case-based learning...

long-covid.title: Development and initial content validation of the Vienna post-exertional malaise questionnaire: an iterative mixed-methods study.
long-covid.journal: Quality of life research : an international journal of quality of life aspects of treatment, care and rehabilitation
long-covid.authors: Pimminger, Theresa, Ahrens-Schwabe, Annika, Fragner, Tobias, Brandl, Tobias et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Post-exertional malaise (PEM) is a multidimensional exertion-response pattern involving diverse triggers, variable onset, and prolonged recovery. This study developed and content-validated the Vienna Post-Exertional Malaise (VPEM) Questionnaire, a patient-reported outcome measure assessing functional decline, recovery, crash-associated symptoms, and pacing adaptations in ME/CFS.

long-covid.title: A New Outlook on Infection-Associated Chronic Conditions and Illnesses.

long-covid.excerpt: Infection-associated chronic conditions and illnesses (IACCI) encompass several debilitating syndromes with overlapping symptoms that have been identified and documented for decades, primarily following infectious disease outbreaks. Conditions following infection that are diagnosed with objective clinical tests have been relatively well characterized and accepted by the medical establishment, although the...

long-covid.title: Sex-Specific Plasma Proteomic Alterations Underpin Distinct COVID-19 Progression and Post-COVID-19 Condition.
long-covid.authors: Lu, Qiuhan, Zhang, Yi, Yi, Shiyu, Wu, Yuwen et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Sex differences in COVID-19 and its sequelae remain poorly understood, which hinders targeted therapies. We performed plasma proteomic analyses of 69 hospitalized patients with COVID-19 and 30 healthy controls from a prospective Chinese cohort.

long-covid.title: Incidence and risk factors of acute respiratory illness associated with influenza, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus within a birth cohort study.
long-covid.authors: Bird, Bryden, Thorn, Louise, Aminisani, Nayyereh, Wood, Tim et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Influenza virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) are leading causes of acute respiratory infections (ARIs). New Zealand's coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) public health measures disrupted the circulation of these viruses in 2020-2021, creating a rare opportunity to explore the impact of potential immunity gaps on age-specific infection risk.

long-covid.title: A novel model demonstrating that human immune cells promote multiorgan SARS-CoV-2 dissemination and human T cells limit anti-viral innate immunity.
long-covid.authors: Wolabaugh, Amber, Agashe, Vrushali V, Wang, Zicheng, Danzl, Nichole M et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Despite extensive studies, many questions remain regarding the pathology and mechanisms behind Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), and particularly on post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 (PASC). Because existing mouse models cannot recapitulate human immune responses, we developed a human immune system (HIS) mouse model with physiologic expression of hACE2.

long-covid.title: "I Picked Myself Up Through Prayer and Soups": Factors Impeding and Enhancing Long COVID Recovery Among Latinos in South Texas.
long-covid.authors: Alvarez-Hernandez, Luis R, Clark, Loren C, Uzoh, Hemma, Gonzales, Xavier F et al.
long-covid.excerpt: We aimed to understand what factors have impeded and enhanced Long COVID recovery among Latinos in South Texas. Through community partners, 78 participants were part of seven focus groups.

lyme.title: Cardiovascular Manifestations of Lyme Disease.
lyme.authors: Manolis, Antonis A, Manolis, Theodora A, Vouliotis, Apostolos, Manolis, Antonis S
lyme.excerpt: Lyme disease is a tick-borne zoonosis caused by Borrelia burgdorferi that can involve multiple organ systems, including the cardiovascular (CV) system, noted in ~1-10% of untreated patients. This can produce atrioventricular (AV) or bundle branch block, atrial fibrillation, and myopericarditis in the acute phase, and dilated cardiomyopathy in the chronic phase.

mcas.title: Mast Cell-Derived CCL2 Exacerbates Endometriosis Pain via Binding to CCR4.
mcas.journal: Omics : a journal of integrative biology
mcas.authors: Deng, Ya, Chen, Ping, Ding, Haigang
mcas.excerpt: Endometriosis (EMs) pain severely reduces patients' quality of life, but its underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. Mast cells and C-C motif chemokine ligand 2 (CCL2) are highly abundant in EMs lesions, yet their roles in neural sensitization remain unclear.

mcas.title: Basophil and eosinophil dynamics as predictors of omalizumab resistance in chronic spontaneous urticaria.
mcas.authors: Oraloğlu, Göktürk, Süne, Ceren, Duman, Nilay, Demirel, Boratay Erin et al.
mcas.excerpt: Chronic spontaneous urticaria is a mast cell-driven skin disorder in which basophils and eosinophils contribute to inflammation. Omalizumab is effective for many patients, yet a subset remains resistant.
